title: Prescribed Beurling densities in spectral eigen-subspaces
summary: Let $(q,D,L)$ be a one-dimensional Hadamard triple with $2\leq m:=\#D<q$, and let $μ_{q,D}$ be the associated self-similar probability measure. Write $\mathcal T=\{t\in\mathbb Z:(q,D,tL)\text{ is a Hadamard triple}\}$. We prove that, for every $0<s<\log m/\log q$ and every $ζ\in[0,+\infty]$, there are continuum many spectra $Λ$ of $μ_{q,D}$ such that $tΛ$ is a spectrum for every $t\in\mathcal T$, $\dim_{\mathrm{Be}}Λ=s$, and $D_s^+(Λ)=ζ$.
